title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.13
subtitle: Responsive preparation and easier Softbody authoring.

highlights.title: Cancel during preparation
highlights.description: Stop preparation before the solver starts, with cleanup of temporary geometry, capture data and Bake reservations.

highlights.title: Reuse Collider geometry
highlights.description: Changing Softbody material values reuses verified static Collider geometry. The Bake window clearly shows reuse or export.

highlights.title: Appear Solid
highlights.description: Give Softbodies a stiff, shape-preserving material with one checkbox. Turning it off restores your previous values, even after saving and reopening.

highlights.title: Clearer Material Zone overlays
highlights.description: Stronger highlights sit slightly above the surface so selections are easier to see.
